verdict.rationale: SolidJS explicitly advertises 'Universal: write custom renderers to use Solid anywhere' with a link to the custom renderer release/feature, plus is web-component friendly, indicating first-party support for targeting non-DOM platforms. missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence of a real non-DOM custom renderer (e.g., native/canvas/terminal target) in production, and deeper documentation beyond a marketing bullet.
